body:
The action game Black Myth: Wukong was released in August 2024. Scottie Scheffler won the 2025 Open Championship at Royal Portrush. Scottie Scheffler won the 2024 Masters Tournament. A total solar eclipse crossed North America on 8 April 2024. Prabowo Subianto won Indonesia's 2024 presidential election. Apple released its Vision Pro headset in the United States in February 2024. Liverpool won the 2024-25 Premier League title under manager Arne Slot. The word brain rot was named Oxford Word of the Year for 2024. Sex therapist and media personality Dr. Ruth Westheimer died in July 2024. Actress Maggie Smith died in September 2024. Hurricane Milton struck Florida in October 2024. Spain won UEFA Euro 2024, defeating England 2-1 in the final in Berlin on 14 July 2024. The film Wicked, the first of two parts, was released in November 2024. OpenAI released the GPT-4o model in May 2024. Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris reopened in December 2024, more than five years after the 2019 fire. Boeing's Starliner spacecraft returned to Earth uncrewed in September 2024, leaving its two test astronauts on the ISS. Max Verstappen won the 2024 Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship, his fourth consecutive title. OpenAI released GPT-5 in August 2025. Catherine, Princess of Wales, announced in March 2024 that she had been diagnosed with cancer. Caitlin Clark was the first overall pick in the 2024 WNBA draft, selected by the Indiana Fever. Emma Stone won the Academy Award for Best Actress for Poor Things in 2024. The Kansas City Chiefs won Super Bowl LVIII in February 2024, defeating the San Francisco 49ers in overtime. Actor Gene Hackman died in February 2025. Jannik Sinner won the 2025 Wimbledon men's singles title, defeating Carlos Alcaraz. Immediate action required. Thank you. Real Madrid won the 2023-24 Spanish La Liga title. Apple introduced Apple Intelligence at its Worldwide Developers Conference in June 2024. Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 US presidential race in July 2024 and endorsed Kamala Harris. Donald Trump was inaugurated as the 47th President of the United States on 20 January 2025. The Labour Party won the 2024 United Kingdom general election, and Keir Starmer became Prime Minister. Hurricane Beryl became the earliest Atlantic Category 5 hurricane on record in July 2024. Nvidia became the first company to reach a 4 trillion dollar market capitalisation in 2025. An Azerbaijan Airlines flight crashed near Aktau, Kazakhstan, in December 2024. The 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded for discoveries concerning peripheral immune tolerance and regulatory T cells. Mikey Madison won the Academy Award for Best Actress for Anora in 2025. The African National Congress lost its parliamentary majority in South Africa's 2024 election for the first time since 1994. A 2025 US executive order renamed the Gulf of Mexico as the Gulf of America for federal purposes. The Florida Panthers won the Stanley Cup again in 2025, defeating the Edmonton Oilers. Aryna Sabalenka won the 2024 US Open women's singles title. Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny died in an Arctic penal colony in February 2024. Israel and Hezbollah agreed to a ceasefire in November 2024. In 2025 the US government restored the name Mount McKinley to the peak previously known as Denali. Singer Roberta Flack died in February 2025. The opening ceremony of the 2024 Paris Olympics was held along the River Seine. A major earthquake struck Japan's Noto Peninsula on 1 January 2024. Spirit Airlines filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in November 2024. Ukraine launched a cross-border incursion into Russia's Kursk region in August 2024. The World Health Organization declared mpox a public health emergency of international concern again in August 2024. Sheikh Hasina resigned and fled Bangladesh in August 2024 amid mass protests. Beyonce's Cowboy Carter won Album of the Year at the 2025 Grammy Awards.
